method_specification.descriptor_stated_b.reason: Sections 2–3 specify the descriptor, training objective, solver, and experimental protocol before the main Results section.

method_specification.architecture_fully_.reason: The paper specifies eight Gaussian radial functions, width and centers, moment orders 1–4, the 152-component pilot, eigendecomposition, 40-channel descriptor, 860-coefficient quadratic head, cutoff, objective, scaling, and singular-value cutoff. This non-neural architecture is reproducible from the paper.

method_specification.hyperparameters_lis.reason: Concrete settings sufficiently specify the protocol: cutoff 5.594 Å, eight radial functions, width 0.65 Å, four moment orders, energy/force weights 100/1, SVD cutoff 1e-13, column-norm floor 1e-14, split seeds, and no augmentation or ridge penalty.

method_specification.invariance_claims_s.reason: Translation invariance follows from relative coordinates, rotation invariance from contracted tensor norms, and permutation invariance from neighbor sums. The paper explains why learned radial mixing preserves these properties and forces transform equivariantly.

method_specification.energy_form_preserv.reason: A separately fitted least-squares linear-plus-quadratic head acts on the frozen learned descriptor. There is no free constant, all channels vanish without neighbors, and forces are analytic energy derivatives.

method_specification.motivation_grounded.reason: The method is specifically positioned against moment tensors, ACE, proper orthogonal descriptors, tensor-reduced representations, CACE, NequIP, and MACE. The paper distinguishes supervised pilot-based compression from their representations and training procedures.
